scope: 25 discovered public repositories; not an exhaustive census

competitors.evidence: C codec and compatibility/performance baseline; benchmark both the pinned 1.6.1 oracle and current stable release.
Claims complete Rust codec, conformance and SIMD speedups; runtime zero-dependency claim does not include its dev dependencies.
Claims complete codec plus Ogg and zero dependencies; inspected manifest has empty normal/dev dependency sections. Strong installation and file-workflow baseline.
Claims bit-exact full codec, SIMD, multistream and projection; manifest includes several normal dependencies and optional C comparison tooling.
Claims full codec and heap-free no_std option; default runtime footprint differs from optional libm/portable-atomic and test dependencies.
Claims conformant decoder, compatible encoder, Ogg and Python integration; no_std decoder uses alloc. Good API and packaging comparison.
Fixed-point Rust port with comparison harness, codec modules, four CLIs, C ABI and player integration. Important fixed-point and tooling baseline.
Fork of opus-rs with codec controls, multichannel and performance claims. Keep lineage visible rather than count shared code as independent evidence.
Published as opus-decoder; claims all modes, all output rates, 12 conformance vectors and no unsafe/FFI. Closest safety-oriented decoder baseline.
Claims RFC-based full decoder/encoder and exact final ranges on all official vectors; one thiserror dependency. Final-range parity alone is not PCM parity.
Pure-Go codec with caller-buffer APIs, Ogg, multistream, ambisonics and RTP RED; explicit matched-workload benchmarks and scalar/SIMD distinctions.
Pure-Go port with separate SIMD dependency; claims complete decoder and reference parity. Compare exact advertised encoder modes separately.
Pure-Go codec in the Pion ecosystem; API readability and WebRTC integration baseline. README alone does not establish complete encoder support.
C#/Java/Go ports based on older fixed-point libopus; useful portability/API baseline, not the sole modern speed or quality reference.
Claims full decoder conformance and standards-compatible encoder, with documented exclusions. Do not infer byte-exact encoder parity.
Transpiled Go implementation; compare compiler/runtime overhead separately from hand-written portable implementations.
Safe bindings to libopus (crate opus), requiring C build tooling by default. Not an independent codec; useful Rust ergonomics and FFI-overhead baseline.
High-level libopus binding; useful integration baseline. Record the linked libopus version rather than attribute its performance to a separate codec.
Encode, inspect and decode file workflows; baseline for eventual Opura CLI behavior and output correctness.
Ogg Opus decoding and seeking API; baseline for pre-skip, gain, seeking, duration and chained-file behavior.
Multimedia CLI and library workflows; isolate codec work from demux, resampling, process startup and I/O in performance comparisons.
Synchronous rusty-opus fork; track API/packaging differences without treating inherited benchmarks as independent measurements.
Current README describes a clean-room rebuild with SILK PCM work. Search snippets describe an older state; assess each current mode independently.
README explicitly says most functionality is not working; not a full-codec performance baseline.
Pure-Rust decoder project; brief README provides too little evidence to rank current conformance or speed.
